text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thanks as always for the fan signs!
I always look forward to seeing what message you'll write next!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Because Royce-chan gives fan service that matches the messages! That makes me so super happy~~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look forward to the next live show, okay?♪
Happy Valentine's♡

A day off before Valentine's.
Royce and Royce was holding a small fan meeting
in front of a shop.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You came all the way from Kansai?! I'm so happy!
Your letters always give me so much encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
! M-Me too! To the hardworking Royce-chan...!
Seeing your run in the Kikuka Sho in person was amazing!

The line of fans never broke right until time ran out,
making the event a massive success with high satisfaction.
choice_data_list: That fan meet will lead to the next one!
That fan meet will lead us nicely into what's next!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Seeing the happy looks on everyone's faces... Hehehe,
it turned out to be a wonderful Valentine's event!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—That is precisely why next year's event must surpass this year's satisfaction,
or it won't become a memorable event.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We'll probably have more fans next year, too...
I need to start thinking about what we should do.
choice_data_list: Plans for next year already?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We also have to book a venue,
so we need to move fast! We need rehearsals too.
choice_data_list: Rehearsal? Why?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I plan to make it an interactive experience.
Rather than just getting chocolate and being done with it, experiencing something together will leave a much stronger memory, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I'll think of something by Valentine's.
So, can I practice on you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: O-Okay, got it

text_block_list.text: Rehearsing for next year's Valentine's Day on this year's Valentine's Day. Things have gotten rather complicated—
On the day of Valentine's, upon entering the Trainer's office—
An envelope had been placed on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To Trainer-san:
I made this Valentine's project into a treasure hunt!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Use the hints on the message card to search for the treasure, okay?♪

Written on the message card was: 'The school newspaper's classmate special feature.
The Umamusume paired with me on that page.'
choice_data_list: A special feature in the school newspaper, huh...

text_block_list.text: That was just before her debut. When interviewed by the school newspaper, she gave them advice on their page layout.
I was thoroughly impressed by how exceptional her research and analytical skills regarding the academy students were.
choice_data_list: (I remember feeling so rushed, thinking I had to catch up to Royce...)

text_block_list.text:
She suggested Sakura Chitose O as her opponent,
saying the two of them would create a great contrast between stillness and motion.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my...
Royce-san's Trainer...?"
choice_data_list: Um, did Royce leave anything with you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes... over here, correct?
Hohoho... what a delightful little game this seems to be.
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.text: The hint written on the card was "The Umamusume who ate soft serve ice cream with me during last year's summer training camp."
"During the summer training camp of the Classic Year, we built the foundation of our youth with BNW."

"To get closer with BNW,
I proposed high-altitude training and set up the environment,
which she utilized brilliantly."
choice_data_list: (I wonder if I was able to help back then, even a little...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the thing from Royce, right!
Hold on a second.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yes, here you go!
Now then, the next clue is—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm, I'm so curious what's written there...
Ah, no, I know I shouldn't look!
choice_data_list: ...It's probably fine to look.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? ...What's this? A riddle?
'The place where the "strongest Umamusume" stand side by side'...?"

The hints Royce and Royce left behind
were based on experiences they had shared together.
choice_data_list: I see... A trip down memory lane, then.

text_block_list.text:
Tracing back through memorable places and people while hunting for treasure.
It was also a way to look back
on the time spent with her.

This will undoubtedly deepen your feelings for her
and make for an even more unforgettable experience.
choice_data_list: (I've started to be able to read her intentions.)

text_block_list.text:
Tracing back through my memories with her,
I could truly feel the deepening of our bond.
choice_data_list: And so, heading towards the next place—

text_block_list.text:
—The hint is:
"A place where the 'Strongest Umamusume' stand side by side."

The day her debut was decided, we visited this place together.
It is our starting point, where we confirmed our goal to become 'the strongest.'

What comes to mind is the memory of her,
eyes sparkling as she talked about the "strongest Umamusume"—
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's somewhere inside the building...)

text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, correct♪
You found your way here properly, didn't you?
choice_data_list: !? Royce...!?

text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought I heard her voice,
my vision was suddenly plunged into darkness.

Shh...! Inside the hall, stay quiet.
Now, just close your eyes—

A breathy voice tickles my ear.
As I close my eyes, the warmth on my eyelids pulls away.

—Instead, a small weight dropped
softly into my coat pocket.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: It's my treasured reward.
As the voice faded away, I slowly opened my eyes.
—However, she was nowhere to be found...
choice_data_list: Ah, Pocket...

text_block_list.text:
Reaching inside, my fingertips brush against an angular box.
Through the chic wrapping paper,
the faint, mellow aroma of cacao wafts up.

—The next morning.
I spot Royce and Royce and call out to her.
choice_data_list: Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Good morning.
Did you enjoy the treasure hunt yesterday?
choice_data_list: Ah... Yeah. I think taking a trip down memory lane is a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
Fufu, I was pretty confident in it~♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Alright, next year's event will definitely be a treasure hunt!
choice_data_list: Um, about yesterday's chocolate...

text_block_list.text:
The chocolate that was in my pocket yesterday.
In case it was meant for a rehearsal, I brought it along just as it was.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's for you, Trainer.
As a token of my daily appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—It's a chocolate orange.
Made with high-cacao chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Pairing it with orange softens the bitterness,
making it delicious to eat.
I tasted it myself, so I can guarantee the flavor.
choice_data_list: Thank you, I'll gladly have some!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're very welcome♪
choice_data_list: Still, if that's the case, why did you head home early yesterday?
Still, if that's the case, why did you go home early yesterday?

text_block_list.text:
Since she wasn't around anymore, I spent all of last night worrying
about whether it was all right for me to accept the chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, wasn't that delightfully mysterious?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Who were these leftover chocolates meant for?
Why did they leave just the chocolate behind
and walk away without saying a word?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Until you found the answer, you must have been
thinking about me the e~ntire time.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—That is what makes it a special experience.
It must have left a strong impression on you, right?”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, playing with the dark might just work.
I'll need to tweak how I hand over the chocolate, though—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I hope Valentine's Day with Royce
became an unforgettable memory♪

Even her anguish was dancing in the palm of her hand.
Completely manipulated by the scheme, she was left with unforgettable memories intertwined with raw emotion—

I thought she was behind me,
so hearing her voice suddenly so close made me involuntarily—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey!
Why are you opening your eyes!"
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! I sensed someone there and reacted without thinking...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*... If we make a scene, we'll cause trouble.
Let's head outside."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: So... how was your treasure hunting experience?
choice_data_list: I think retracing our memories is a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Right? I'm so glad♪
choice_data_list: Still, that final performance seems like it could cause some issues.

text_block_list.text: There are many impractical aspects to this, such as handing out chocolates to her countless fans.

I can't imagine she would fail to notice
a problem of this degree, but...
choice_data_list: Is there a reason you were so particular about that staging?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: If I just hand over the chocolate like normal, it'll definitely get buried under all the others...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's why I thought really hard
about what I could do to leave an impression...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I figured all I had to do was make your heart race!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Still... I guess I couldn't make your heart race, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: N-No, my heart was definitely pounding!

text_block_list.text:
Being deprived of vision is truly unsettling.
Not knowing what might happen certainly made my heart race.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wonder if a pitch-black staging would work?
I really want to leave an impression with an impactful experience.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Revealing that 'I just wanted everyone's hearts to race!' might also be good to show your earnestness!"
choice_data_list: (Wait, that was part of the drill too?!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
By the way, about that chocolate wrapping.
Did you notice anything about it?

Urged on, I check it. The wrapping paper is plain,
with no shop logo or anything of the sort.
Which means, it's not a store-bought product, but—
choice_data_list: Huh? Don't tell me, it's handmade!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Royce is so happy you noticed!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It was tough making them from scratch,
but I made them while looking back on all
my memories with you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Chocolates filled with soft-serve ice cream-flavored cream, and chocolates filled with plum jam.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the plum jam chocolate is inspired
by medicinal cuisine, you see.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Not only will I reflect on our memories,
I'll also infuse those memories into the chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "And then follow it up with a combo line like, 'I made this while looking back on our memories!'"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's guaranteed to leave an impression
stronger than any chocolate, no doubt about it!
choice_data_list: (Huh? No, no way, isn't that impossible?)

text_block_list.text:
It's impossible to make handmade chocolate for every single fan.
In that case, practicing on the premise of making handmade chocolate seems kinda pointless to begin with—
choice_data_list: (Then what were the handmade chocolates for?)

text_block_list.text:
Wait, are these really homemade chocolates?
If they're store-bought, that's impossible for a Memory Link—
choice_data_list: (Wait, how much of this is part of the exercise!?)
(Wait, how much of this is part of the exercise!?)

text_block_list.text: I can't read the truth behind her words at all...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... What a great expression♪
You're confused, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I wonder if my self-producing this year was a smashing success.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.text:
When we brought them home and opened them up,
we found chocolates flavored like soft serve and plum jam—
Although the chocolate turned out to be handmade, her true intentions remained utterly perplexing.

—However, one thing was certain:
it was a Valentine's Day no one would ever forget.
